gloss: working away from home; migrant work

definitions.gloss: working away from home; migrant work
definitions.explanation: Leaving one's hometown or home country to work elsewhere, typically to send money back home. Often seasonal or temporary.

examples.japanese: {出稼|でかせ}ぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go work away from home.
During winter, he went to the city for seasonal work.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}→労働者：23971_roudousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出稼|でかせ}ぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕送|しおく}り→仕送り：16344_shiokuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many workers go abroad for work and send money home to their families.

notes:
{出稼|でかせ}ぎ is a noun derived from the verb ⟦{稼|かせ}ぐ→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧ (to earn) with the prefix {出|で} (going out). It refers to leaving home specifically for the purpose of earning money.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出稼|でかせ}ぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go work away from home)
- {出稼|でかせ}ぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to leave for migrant work)
- {出稼|でかせ}ぎ⟦{労働者|ろうどうしゃ}→労働者：23971_roudousha⟧ (migrant worker)
- ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧{出稼|でかせ}ぎ (seasonal migrant work)

USAGE:
Historically, {出稼|でかせ}ぎ was common among farmers from northern Japan who went to cities for work during winter. In modern usage, it also applies to international labor migration. In Brazil and other countries with Japanese diaspora communities, the word "dekasegi" has entered local vocabulary to describe Japanese-Brazilians working in Japan.
